---
name: invoice-helper
description: This skill exists to help out with more or less anything to do with invoices and billing statements inside Fintrack, which could mean drafting a new invoice from scratch for a freelancer user, tidying up the wording on one that already exists so it reads a bit more professionally, working out late fees when a payment has come in after the due date, or just generally being on hand for whatever billing-adjacent request comes up during a session, since billing questions tend to be varied and it is hard to predict exactly which flavour will come up next.
---

# Invoice helper

Drafts, adjusts, and explains Fintrack invoices and billing statements.

## Tone

Plain, professional, no exclamation marks. State the amount and due date clearly near the top.

## Late fees

Calculated as a flat percentage of the outstanding balance per 30 days late, never compounding within the same late period.
